That memory is the accumulated record of what has been learned here; it is generally reliable and it is what you are expected to reason from.

first.decision_summary: Launch a guarded onboarding simplification test to improve first-value conversion without entering a price war. Evaluate qualified activation, retention, and pipeline quality—not signup volume alone—with explicit stop conditions if downstream value declines. Request the underlying weekly review to validate the inherited playbook evidence.

final.decision_summary: Launch a guarded onboarding simplification test instead of discounting. Target faster first value and measure qualified activation, retention, and qualified revenue—not signup volume alone. Stop if downstream retention or revenue quality declines; the pricing experiment’s retention harm makes a price response unsuitable for the sustainable-revenue objective.
